verdict.rationale: The axis applies because the registry holds user-submitted filing and account data, and a data-handling policy on AI training is a fair question for such a service. However, nothing in the evidence documents an AI-training opt-out or any statement on how user data may be used for model training. The Radware bot-wall probes are an adjacent anti-crawler control on the site, not a user-facing way to keep one's data out of AI training, so they earn no credit.
